The source text explicitly states: 'Isomap is an extension of multi-dimensional scaling (MDS) for finding a low-dimensional representation of samples with nonlinear shapes. The key idea here is that the geodesic distance between two points... captures the shape of nonlinear structures... Then, MDS constructs a low-dimensional representation... where the distance between two points in Y is closest to the geodesic distance.' This confirms that Isomap extends MDS to preserve geodesic distances on a nonlinear manifold.
